method: Compare current working-file Git blob hashes to exact accepted-main tree population; includes all historical release, release-evidence, examples, Profile1.2 diagnostic and assurance witness files.
test_side_effects: Some legacy remediation tests regenerate working fixture copies in place. Those generated copies were restored byte-for-byte from accepted Git objects; final reruns use a disposable detached worktree. No historical changes are committed or published.
